text.p: The Zephyr integration uses the Percepio TraceRecorder library and the usage is documented in Using TraceRecorder v4.6 or later.
To integrate the TraceRecorder in a Zephyr project, follow the TraceRecorder integration guide at https://percepio.com/getstarted/latest/html/zephyr.html/.

The TraceRecorder source code is included in the Zephyr repository and included through the Zephyr KConfig system. If needed, you also find the very latest version of the TraceRecorder source code in the Percepio repository on https://github.com/Percepio/TraceRecorderSource.
See TraceRecorder API for pointers to the TraceRecorder code documentation.
